items.scene: A toddler makes a big FUSS ("FAHS") in front of the mirror, scrunching her FACE up like a prune.
A dermatologist checks a boy's SKIN with a magnifying glass while he peels a POtato ("POH"), its SKIN curling off in one long ribbon.
A ZOO ("ZHOO") keeper in khaki gets a big kiss on the CHEEK from a baby elephant's trunk, and the cheek glows pink.
A FIGURE skater ("fee-GEWR") twirls and admires her own beaming FACE in the big mirror.
A border guard holds up a traveller's VISA ("vee-ZAHZH") and compares the photo with his FACE, nose to nose.
A uniformed attendant points a buzzing SHAVER ("shuh-VEUH") at the ONE single HAIR on top of a giant boiled egg on a stand.
A sailor boy shouts "AHOY!" ("UHY") as he peers through a brass spyglass with one EYE, the other screwed shut.
A furry little creature clings to a WALL ("PWAHL"), its HAIR all fluffed up.

prompt:
Gentle storybook painterly illustration, realism about 3.5/5, soft gouache-and-oil brushwork, warm-hearted and calm, natural NEUTRAL daylight with true colours, off-white whites, no orange, sepia, amber or golden cast, no pink or blue tint, clear readable figures with contact shadows on the floor, consistent eye-level perspective, 16:9 wide composition.
Scene: Le miroir in the B17_cabinet building, ground floor (west alcove). Camera: inside the alcove, facing the big mirror on the west wall.
Setting: lavender-grey damask wallpaper with a white cornice; floor: polished black-and-white marble in a diamond pattern. Landmark: a huge three-panel gilt dressing-table mirror ringed with round bulbs, filling the back wall. Light: soft daylight plus the gentle glow of the mirror bulbs. The room feels lived-in and real, with depth (never an empty white backdrop).
Paint these exits clearly as walkable openings: the archway in the near RIGHT foreground showing primrose-yellow walls (way to Le cabinet ORL).
Characters and objects, each a separate, clearly spaced group, feminine-word groups on the left half and masculine-word groups on the right half:
- far left, foreground: A toddler makes a big FUSS in front of the mirror, scrunching her FACE up like a prune.
- far left, middle distance: A dermatologist checks a boy's SKIN with a magnifying glass while he peels a POtato, its SKIN curling off in one long ribbon.
- left, foreground: A ZOO keeper in khaki gets a big kiss on the CHEEK from a baby elephant's trunk, and the cheek glows pink.
- centre-left, middle distance: A FIGURE skater twirls and admires her own beaming FACE in the mirror.
- centre, foreground: A border guard holds up a traveller's VISA and compares the photo with his FACE, nose to nose.
- centre-right, middle distance: A buzzing SHAVER chases ONE single HAIR across the shiny bald head of a giant boiled egg.
- right, foreground: A huge friendly EYEBALL on little legs, in a sailor's cap, waves from the mirror stool as if calling "AHOY".
- far right, middle distance: A furry little creature clings to a WALL, its HAIR all fluffed up.
Leave a blank light board for the room sign high on the back wall. No written words, letters, numbers or logos anywhere (signs and plaques are blank boards). No blood, no wounds, no needles in skin (syringes only as capped harmless props), no alcohol, no smoking, no religious symbols, no red-cross emblem. Nobody cropped by the image edge; keep every figure well inside the frame with a clear gap between figures. Figures stand on the floor or sit on real furniture, never floating or in rows behind a counter.
